column1: # The reviewer CLIs crossreview knows: one row per agent, tab-separated.
# Read by scripts/crossreview.py, scripts/detect-agents.sh and scripts/detect-agents.ps1.
# binaries: candidates in preference order (comma-separated; a space adds a fixed subcommand).
# marker: a word --version or --help must print, so an unrelated executable of the same name is skipped.
# models: arguments that list the agent's models, '-' when it has no such command.
# posix / powershell: command templates; {bin}, {model}, {brief} and {out} are placeholders.
# Every template feeds the brief through stdin or a file flag, except koda's: that CLI takes the
# prompt only as an argument, and the helper refuses it when the brief is too long for one.
# The PowerShell column hands redirection to cmd.exe (--% passes the rest verbatim), which moves
# bytes as they are: PowerShell's own | and > re-encode text (UTF-16, the OEM code page).
